title: docs(adr): ADR-0160 seventh amendment — the shell 问 AI button is the one entry, focus defaults to the page record, ask_ai retired, pack read on demand

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4cQAcSj519z7moNo7rHocp)_

Fixes #37854

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感：这是设计文档修订，把 11 月 27 日关于「问 AI」入口的裁定写进记录范围问询的设计文档，代码不变。
- 属于「问 AI 入口改造」专题，是撤掉页面内问 AI 动作、默认带当前记录、按需读取资料这几张实现卡的前置。
- 写错的话后续实现卡会按错的规则做，但本文档随时可以再修订撤回。
- 要你做什么：审核席位意见后批准合并这个受管设计文档。

## What changes
One file: `docs/adr/0160-record-scoped-ai-inquiry.md`, the seventh amendment (2026-11-27), for card #37854 (C0a of topic #37853). Tree readings taken on `main` at `adb65d16`.

- **Header**: a new `Amended` bullet quoting the maintainer's rulings of 2026-11-27 verbatim with their UTC times (06:27Z, 06:28Z, 06:30Z, 06:32Z, 06:33Z, 07:12Z), and separating them from this record's own settlements.
- **Title and TL;DR 6–8**: the entry is the shell's 「问 AI」 button; `ask_ai` is retired; the in-app assistant reads the pack on demand.
- **D6**: the `focus` contract is unchanged. "Entry point" is rewritten (the shell button and no other, no app rename, no page button, no focus setter). New paragraph "The focus of a conversation": state `{ focus, dismissed }`; before the first send the focus is the page record (`surfaceRecord()`) unless dismissed; × clears it and nothing re-adds it; the first send fixes both; the pin and the 「改为问《X》？」 prompt are removed; the page chip 「正在看：X」 stays when there is no focus.
- **D7**: kept as a retired section (anchor `#d7` unchanged) with the ruling and the 2026-11-24 text preserved. Adds the ADR-0087 retirement route (`enumWithRetiredValues` on `ActionType`, the action `type` key's second enum and the button rows' open string answering with the same prescription, one conversion in `conversions/entries/19/` retired from the load path, one D3 semantic entry, a `narrowed` changeset with a `registered` disposition) and "What a legacy `ask_ai` action meets": refused where authored; `os migrate meta --from 18` deletes only an unreferenced action; metadata at rest is read without the action, with the door's existing conversion notice.
- **D8, D4 seam 1, rows 6 and 9**: first-turn pre-read becomes read on demand (pointer only; the model calls `get_record_context` when the user refers to the record; fallback `get_record`). Row 6 is marked retired.
- **Points that go past the card's words**: points 25–32 are this record's settlements, accepted with the maintainer's merge (notably point 31, at-rest behaviour, which no ruling covers and the card asked this record to decide).
- **Implementation split**: the epic #36996 "Done when", old and new text.

## Tests
Docs-only. No code, no schema, no changeset (`docs/adr/**` ships in no package: `skip-changeset`).

## Acceptance notes
Premise readings on `adb65d16` (all on the tree):
- `ActionType` at `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:706`; precedent `agent.zod.ts:161,173` holds.
- Corrected: an action's own `type` key (`action.zod.ts:1446`, in `actionObject()`) is a second enum with its own error, so a prescription on `ActionType` alone would not reach `type:'ask_ai'`. The amendment names that slot and the button rows' open string (`component.zod.ts`) for card #37856.
- Corrected: `ask_ai` appears only under `## 19.0.0-next.0` in `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`; it never shipped in a stable 18.x. The text says so.
- `applyConversionsToStoredItem` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts`) returns a row unchanged when a conversion yields no item, so "skip at load" needs card #37856 to extend that seam; the amendment records it.
- Showcase `task-detail.page.ts:67` names the action `showcase_ask_about_task`, so the conversion must not auto-delete referenced actions.

Settlements the approver may want to check: point 25 (× stays after the first send), points 29–30 (inline actions and button rows included in the retirement), point 31 (at-rest behaviour), and the spec docblocks' word "pinned", assigned to card #37861.
